summary: Change makes Powder not_found for the current tracker:powder Subject a blocking error in reconcilePowderPrimary, so Builder dispatch and later approve pre-check fail until the job exists again or primary moves on, while a post-atomic-push not_found only reports powder_status:pending without undoing a landed Gate. Production change is one line; tests cover reconcile-not-found, builder-block, pre-approve-block, and landed-approve-pending. A test-only env helper isolates the CLI signal fixture from ambient Powder vars. All four configured checks pass (build 0, vet 0, test 0, secrets 0) and fc77909 fast-forwards origin/master f360877.
